name: repowise
description: Codebase intelligence for Claude Code. Indexes your codebase into five layers (Graph, Git, Docs, Decisions, Code Health) and exposes them through task-shaped MCP tools, so Claude understands architecture, ownership, hotspots, why code is built the way it is, and where the defect risk lives.

lens_margin.title: Lens margin notes
lens_margin.description: Under an Edit or Write, show the governing decision or recent fix history the Repowise hook flagged for that file.

lens_squeeze.title: Lens squeeze rows
lens_squeeze.description: Under a Bash result that repowise distill shortened, show the lines before and after and the command that restores the rest.

lens_review.title: Lens change review
lens_review.description: After a turn that edits files, review the working tree with get_change_risk and show the result beneath Claude's answer.

lens_flow.title: Lens Flow tab
lens_flow.description: Show a dashboard of each turn in the /lens pane's Flow tab: what an edit reaches that Claude did not look at, the files it worked from, what filled its context, and what Repowise answered.

lens_pane_autoopen.title: Open the Lens map on the first read
lens_pane_autoopen.description: Opens the Lens map pane when Claude first reads a file, if the terminal is wide enough to place it without asking. /lens opens it at any time.

lens_map_health.title: Lens map health colours
lens_map_health.description: Colours the Lens map's tiles by code health from the start. Off, the map is quiet tiles that light up with the files Claude touches; the Health colours button in the map turns the bands on at any time.
